title: ElevenLabs Word Pronunciation Audio
description: Generate audio pronunciations for individual words using ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API. Users can click on a word to hear how it's pronounced, helping them learn correct pronunciation even when song delivery differs from normal speech.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create a utility function to call ElevenLabs TTS API
List available voices and select appropriate one for Persian/Farsi
Create script to generate audio for all unique words in seed data
Save generated audio files to public/audio/words/{word}.mp3
Handle special characters in filenames (URL encode or transliterate)
Add click handler to word tokens in LyricsDisplay component
When word is clicked, play the corresponding audio file
Show visual feedback when word audio is playing (highlight or pulse)
Handle missing audio gracefully (word not yet generated)
Add loading state while audio is being fetched
Audio plays at normal speech pace (not song pace)
Multiple rapid clicks don't overlap audio (stop previous, play new)

implementationNotes.voiceSelection: Use eleven_multilingual_v2 model for Persian/Farsi support

blockedBy: ElevenLabs API key has 0 credits. User needs to add credits to ELEVENLABS_API_KEY before running scripts/generate-word-audio.ts to generate audio files.
